footer.tagline: Luxury landing pages for professional affiliate marketers. Showcase your Amazon, Walmart and Target picks in one link.

hero.title: One elegant link for all your affiliate picks
hero.subtitle: Create a luxury showcase page for your Amazon, Walmart, Target and other offers. Every product gets a review page and a "Buy on Walmart"-style button that sends buyers to your affiliate link.
hero.note: Free to start · Your commissions stay 100% yours

features.title: Everything a pro affiliate needs
features.subtitle: Spend your time choosing great products. We handle design, speed and tracking.

luxury.title: Luxury showcase
luxury.desc: Premium cards, featured picks, search and filters — a page that looks like a curated boutique.

stores.title: Store logos & buy buttons
stores.desc: Each card shows the store logo, and each review ends with a "Buy on Amazon" button in the store's colors.

reviews.title: Reviews that convert
reviews.desc: Short review, pros & cons, key features, specs, verdict and your score out of 5.

analytics.title: Click analytics
analytics.desc: Daily views and clicks, click-through rate and your top-performing offers.

seo.title: SEO & sharing
seo.desc: Clean URLs, social previews and product review structured data for search engines.

disclosure.title: Disclosure built in
disclosure.desc: An editable affiliate disclosure on every page to keep you compliant with FTC and Amazon.

languages.title: English, Arabic, French
languages.desc: Choose your page language — including full right-to-left support for Arabic.

themes.title: Themes & brand color
themes.desc: Midnight, Noir or Ivory themes with your accent color, avatar, cover and social links.

s1.title: Pick your link
s1.desc: Choose your page name and URL, for example yoursite.com/your-name.

s2.title: Add your offers
s2.desc: Paste your affiliate link — we detect the store — then add photos, price and your review.

s3.title: Share & earn
s3.desc: Put your link in your bio, videos and posts. Track every click from your dashboard.

cta.title: Your boutique of picks is one minute away
cta.subtitle: Join marketers who turned a list of links into a page people trust.

register.title: Create your affiliate page
register.subtitle: One account, one elegant link for all your offers.
